notes.title: "Graze Counter GM" WANTS you to play dangerously!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=UdcxDrR-5Dw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously![/b]

"Graze" past enemy bullets to charge your "Graze Counter", then unleash it upon your enemies as a highly deadly attack! 
Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486440/

notes.title: [Patch note:Ver1.12] Game capacity reduction and bug fixes
notes.notes:

[/list]

notes.title: Graze Counter Demo has released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29519878/246f7a84fe6a1121657de43142c91623f27e2a6d.png[/img]

[b]Graze counter Demo is available now![/b]
Click "Download Demo" in the right column of store page ;)

Demo version has following limitations.:
[list]
    [*]Only stage 1 is playable.
    [*]Mission mode is limited to 10 stages.
    [*]Only Type-1 and Type-2 fighter are available.
(You can not use unlockable fighters) 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy it.
Thank you!
